resolution: bootstrap.paths derives platform-native runtime home and use environment; there is no silent fallback when LOCALAPPDATA/XDG home is invalid.

roles.development: canonical writable checkout, never mutate active use path
roles.use: separate user-scoped managed launcher and manifest; no game Mods install or daemon
roles.worktrees: agent isolation only, not second mutable canonical clone
roles.locks: User-scoped shared UI-input mutex, not inside any clone/worktree. 0700 directory on POSIX; stale locks fail closed.

installation: bootstrap.py install clones only if canonical checkout absent and writes only manifest-owned launcher+manifest
uninstallation: bootstrap.py uninstall deletes only verified, manifest-owned launcher and manifest. A checkout is eligible for automatic removal only if this installer created it, tracked/untracked/ignored data are absent, exactly one Git worktree remains, and the install-time HEAD, branch, refs, reflogs, config, custom Git metadata and worktree signature match. Missing/legacy signatures preserve the checkout. Uninstall holds an atomic exclusive desktop lock throughout destructive work; active/stale lock files block removal before any managed file is deleted. The empty runtime lock directory is cleaned after release. An empty development parent is removed only if the installer recorded creating it; pre-existing project roots are never removed.
